scope: Production stage timings for an application-only change after project-scoped reconciliation planning

change.behaviour: Planning renders only the affected project subtree when every changed path sits inside one platform/projects/<project>/ tree.

limitations: One bounded production run after the change; the baseline is two bounded runs, so these are single-sample comparisons rather than percentiles.
The kubernetes apply stage still re-reconciles and verifies the whole cluster graph; narrowing it requires verifying the live Kustomization topology for project ownership.
Runner queueing delayed this run before it started, and queue time is excluded from the stage timings.
